name: Lampac-NextGen
author: holopsicon@example.com
description: Lampac NextGen - media aggregator (ASP.NET Core, .NET 10). Installed from the official GitHub release zip; the port from the allocation is written to init.conf on every start.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Lampac NextGen installer for Pelican/Pterodactyl.
# Writes lampac-update.sh (also run on every server start when AUTO_UPDATE=1) and runs it once.
set -e

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
NEED=""
for c in curl unzip; do command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 || NEED="$NEED $c"; done
if [ -n "$NEED" ]; then
  apt-get update -qq
  apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends ca-certificates $NEED
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

cat > /mnt/server/lampac-update.sh <<'LAMPAC_UPDATE_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Installs/updates Lampac NextGen from GitHub releases. Only release files are overwritten;
# user data (init.conf, passwd, *.db, mods/, cache/, wwwroot/, ...) is not part of the release and is kept.
# Version comes from $LAMPAC_VERSION ("latest" or a tag). Set FORCE=1 to reinstall the same version.
set -e
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

REPO="lampac-nextgen/lampac"
ZIP="lampac-nextgen.zip"
WANT="${LAMPAC_VERSION:-latest}"

if [ -z "$WANT" ] || [ "$WANT" = "latest" ]; then
  # The first redirect of /releases/latest/download/<asset> points at .../releases/download/<TAG>/<asset>
  TAG="$(curl -fsSI --retry 3 "https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/latest/download/${ZIP}" | tr -d '\r' \
    | awk -F/ 'tolower($1) ~ /^location:/ { for (i=1;i<NF;i++) if ($i=="download") { print $(i+1); exit } }')"
  [ -n "$TAG" ] || { echo "update: cannot resolve latest release"; exit 1; }
else
  TAG=""
  for t in "$WANT" "v${WANT#v}" "${WANT#v}"; do
    if curl -fsIL -o /dev/null "https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/download/${t}/${ZIP}"; then TAG="$t"; break; fi
  done
  [ -n "$TAG" ] || { echo "update: release '${WANT}' with asset ${ZIP} not found"; exit 1; }
fi

CUR="$(cat version.txt 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [ "$CUR" = "$TAG" ] && [ -f Core.dll ] && [ "${FORCE:-0}" != "1" ]; then
  echo "Lampac ${TAG} is up to date"
  exit 0
fi

echo "Lampac: ${CUR:-none} -> ${TAG}"
# Work inside the server dir: /tmp may be a small tmpfs
mkdir -p .update
trap 'rm -rf .update' EXIT
curl -fSL --retry 3 -o .update/release.zip "https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/download/${TAG}/${ZIP}"
[ -s .update/release.zip ] || { echo "update: empty archive"; exit 1; }
unzip -oq .update/release.zip -d .update/x
rm -f .update/release.zip

# Flatten if the archive has a single root folder
if [ ! -f .update/x/Core.dll ]; then
  SUB="$(find .update/x -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | head -n1)"
  [ -n "$SUB" ] && [ -f "$SUB/Core.dll" ] || { echo "update: Core.dll not found in archive"; exit 1; }
  mv "$SUB" .update/x2 && rm -rf .update/x && mv .update/x2 .update/x
fi

shopt -s dotglob nullglob
cp -a .update/x/* ./
shopt -u dotglob nullglob
echo "$TAG" > version.txt
echo "Lampac ${TAG} installed"
LAMPAC_UPDATE_EOF
chmod +x /mnt/server/lampac-update.sh

FORCE=1 bash /mnt/server/lampac-update.sh

# Minimal init.conf - merged over the built-in base.conf. Port is kept in sync by the panel on every start.
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/init.conf ]; then
  cat > /mnt/server/init.conf <<'EOF'
{
  "listen": {
    "ip": "any",
    "port": 9118
  },
  "chromium": {
    "enable": true,
    "executablePath": "/usr/bin/chromium"
  }
}
EOF
  echo "Created default init.conf"
fi

# Root password (optional)
if [ -n "${ROOT_PASSWORD}" ]; then
  printf '%s' "${ROOT_PASSWORD}" > /mnt/server/passwd
  echo "passwd written from ROOT_PASSWORD"
fi

# FFmpeg (optional, only needed for the Transcoding module)
if [ "${INSTALL_FFMPEG}" = "1" ]; then
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64|amd64)  FF="ffmpeg-master-latest-linux64-gpl" ;;
    aarch64|arm64) FF="ffmpeg-master-latest-linuxarm64-gpl" ;;
    *) FF="" ;;
  esac
  if [ -n "$FF" ]; then
    command -v xz >/dev/null 2>&1 || { apt-get update -qq; apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends xz-utils; }
    mkdir -p /mnt/server/data
    curl -fSL --retry 3 -o /tmp/ffmpeg.tar.xz "https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases/download/latest/${FF}.tar.xz"
    tar -xJf /tmp/ffmpeg.tar.xz -C /tmp --wildcards "*/bin/ffmpeg" "*/bin/ffprobe" --strip-components=2
    mv -f /tmp/ffmpeg /tmp/ffprobe /mnt/server/data/
    chmod +x /mnt/server/data/ffmpeg /mnt/server/data/ffprobe
    rm -f /tmp/ffmpeg.tar.xz
    echo "FFmpeg installed to data/"
  fi
fi

echo "Done."

variables.name: Lampac version
variables.description: Release tag (e.g. v1.2.3) or 'latest'. With Auto update on, the server follows this on each start; user data is kept.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: 1 = on every server start check GitHub for a new release (matching 'Lampac version') and update before launching. If the check fails the installed version still starts.

variables.name: Root password
variables.description: Optional. Written to the 'passwd' file on install (used by WebLog/admin endpoints). If empty, Lampac generates a random one on first start (see the 'passwd' file).

variables.name: Install FFmpeg
variables.description: 1 = download static ffmpeg/ffprobe into data/ on install (needed only for the Transcoding module).
